grammar:
%rule text (Q $x:choice) %conditions ¬($x.without-elision.matches(choice))

%rule choice ($p:prefix (a ≻ b))
%rule prefix X :: (($.starts-input ⟹ Start) ∪ (¬($.starts-input) ⟹ Other))
%rule a (Y [+T])
%rule b (Y [+U])
description: A seal entry distinguishes the tags of an earlier public capture (engine §4 and §10).
